company.name: Recall.ai
company.shortDescription: Recall.ai provides unified APIs and SDKs to capture, transcribe, and analyze recordings and meetings.
company.description: Recall.ai is the infrastructure layer for conversation data. With a single API, developers can access recordings, transcripts, and metadata from meetings, desktops, and phone calls – without managing bots, integrations, or real-time infrastructure. Over 2,000 companies use Recall.ai to build AI products across sales, recruiting, healthcare, and productivity tools.

productsAndServices.description: An API for deploying bots that join video conferences to capture recordings, transcripts, participant data, chat messages, and real-time audio or video.
productsAndServices.name: Meeting Bot API

productsAndServices.description: An SDK for recording video conferences and in-person conversations through a desktop application without placing a recording bot in the meeting.
productsAndServices.name: Desktop Recording SDK

productsAndServices.description: An API that connects calendar events with meeting recordings, providing scheduling data such as participant emails, meeting titles, and event details.
productsAndServices.name: Calendar API

productsAndServices.description: A mobile SDK for capturing recordings of phone calls, VOIP calls, and in-person meetings. The product is listed as coming soon.
productsAndServices.name: Mobile Recording SDK

items.title: Recall.ai: $38 Million Series B Secured For Conversation Data Infrastructure Platform
